mil3.1.8:1.2: Kiṃlakkhaṇo bhante manasikāro, kiṃlakkhaṇā paññā ti. -
mil3.1.8:1.3: Ūhanalakkhaṇo kho mahārāja manasikāro, chedanalakkhaṇā paññā ti. -
mil3.1.8:2.1: Kathaṃ ūhanalakkhaṇo manasikāro, kathaṃ chedanalakkhaṇā paññā;
mil3.1.8:2.6: Vāmena bhante hatthena yavakalāpaṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena dāttaṃ gahetvā dāttena chindantīti. -
mil3.1.8:3.1: Yathā mahārāja yavalāvako vāmena hatthena yavakalāpaṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena dāttaṃ gahetvā dāttena chindati,
mil3.1.8:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yogāvacaro manasikārena mānasaṃ gahetvā paññāya kilese chindati. Evaṃ kho mahārāja ūhanalakkhaṇo manasikāro, eyaṃ chedanalakkhaṇā paññā ti.
